item.title: DPDP: Consent Manager registration opens under the DPDP Act
item.description:
DPDP · Commencement · s. 6(9) and s. 27(1)(d) of the Act; rule 4 of the DPDP Rules, 2025

Effective 2026-11-13.

Who it covers: Companies that want to register as Consent Managers, and Data Fiduciaries that plan to accept consent through them.

  • Rule 4 and the First Schedule apply from 13-11-2026: an Indian company with net worth of at least Rs 2 crore and an independently certified platform may apply to the Board.
  • The Board may inquire into a breach of a Consent Manager's registration conditions (s. 27(1)(d)).
  • The duties of Data Fiduciaries on notice, consent, security and breaches still start on 13-05-2027.

Official source

item.title: DPDP: DPDP (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2026 adjusts the wording of ss. 9(1) and 10(2)(c)(ii)
item.description:
DPDP · Order · S.O. 5458(E) dated 05-10-2026

Effective 2026-10-06.

Who it covers: Data Fiduciaries processing data of children or persons with disability, and Significant Data Fiduciaries.

  • s. 9(1) now refers to the personal data of a child or of a person with disability who has a lawful guardian.
  • s. 10(2)(c)(ii) now requires a periodic data audit.
  • No change to the commencement dates.

Official source

item.title: DPDP: Applications invited for the Chairperson and four Members of the Data Protection Board
item.description:
DPDP · Notice · MeitY vacancy circular of 06-05-2026

Effective 2026-05-06.

Who it covers: The Data Protection Board of India.

  • The Ministry invited applications for one Chairperson and four Members, with applications closing on 06-07-2026.
  • The Board was established on 13-11-2025 and its strength fixed at four Members besides the Chairperson; appointments are made on the recommendation of search-cum-selection committees under rule 17.

Official source

item.description:
DPDP · Corrigendum · G.S.R. 892(E) dated 10-12-2025

item.title: DPDP: DPDP Rules, 2025 notified; Act brought into force in three phases; Data Protection Board established
item.description:
DPDP · Rules and commencement · G.S.R. 843(E), 844(E), 845(E) and 846(E) dated 13-11-2025

Effective 2025-11-13.

Who it covers: Every Data Fiduciary, including banks, NBFCs, insurers, intermediaries and market entities, and their processors.

  • Phase 1 (13-11-2025): definitions, the Board, the rule-making and overriding provisions, and the RTI Act amendment; rules 1, 2 and 17 to 21.
  • Phase 2 (13-11-2026): Consent Manager registration (s. 6(9), rule 4).
  • Phase 3 (13-05-2027): notice, consent, legitimate uses, security, breach intimation, retention, children, Significant Data Fiduciaries, rights, transfers abroad, exemptions, Board inquiries and penalties; omission of IT Act s. 43A.
  • The Board is set up with its head office in the National Capital Region, and the number of its Members is fixed at four.

Official source
